observations: The source describes repository discovery of ACCESSIBILITY.md and its Accessibility-tab/About exposure; file existence is not certification of project accessibility.
Discovery precedence is .github, repository root, then docs. If absent locally, an organization-owned .github repository may supply inherited content.

Page content can document priorities, supported environments, known barriers, contributor expectations, reporting, ownership and maintenance. Source does not universally mandate adopting this exact document.
The Community Standards template procedure is conditional on public repository and fpt/ghec rendering; private repository applicability must not be inferred from this route.
Template comments are hidden by rendering; replace instructions with actual project information rather than treating a populated template as an attestation.
The manual route supports all three discovery paths and adds project-specific information through the file editor.

Both rendered bodies expand shared commit guidance: meaningful commit message, optional coauthors, choose branch, propose change; default-branch editing guidance recommends a new branch and pull request.
Rendered manual guidance additionally explains verified author-email selection and privacy/no-reply defaults; sample screenshot identity is illustrative, not a consumer setting.
The two bodies have the same reviewed substantive content and differing version-prefixed outbound links; identical semantics does not collapse their version-instance denominator.
Supplement feature data advertises GHES >=3.24, beyond the acquired published GHES 3.18-3.22 versions; this does not add unrequested latest-server instances or justify fabricated matches.
remaining_dependencies: Feature resolver implementation and supported-version assurance
